people.name: Jephthah
people.line: A judge of Israel, known for his tragic vow.

people.name: Tob
people.line: Region where Jephthah fled and recruited mercenaries

translations.web: Then Jephthah fled from his brothers and lived in the land of Tob. Outlaws joined up with Jephthah, and they went out with him.
translations.bsb: So Jephthah fled from his brothers and settled in the land of Tob, where worthless men gathered around him and traveled with him.
translations.kjv: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain men to Jephthah, and went out
translations.asv: Then Jephthah fled from his brethren, and dwelt in the land of Tob: and there were gathered vain fellows to Jephthah, and they went out with him.
